thread:
nina: Heads-up: we're GAing Hosted API Stream Adapter + ToolCall v3 next week. Rolling out as opt-in for 48h, then flip to enabled-by-default if signals look good. :tada:

chris: Great — does this require any schema changes from integrators?

nina: No breaking schema changes. Clients can opt into v3 behavior with header `X-RW-Tool-Version: 3`. When absent we auto-negotiate.

marcos: Performance notes? Any numbers we can surface to customers?

nina: Early canary data: p95 reduced ~8% on short responses, and tool-heavy flows saw 5-12% lower token cost due to prefix caching & frame coalescing. We'll include these as example ranges in the support playbook.

ops-bot: Deploy report: release stream-adapter@v1.2 promoted to prod. Canary 48h across 3 regions, error rate stable.

docs-engineering: I'll publish a migration guide + code snippets. Quick curl sample for internal posts: 
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -H "X-RW-Tool-Version: 3" 
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-lite","stream":true,"input":"summarize:..."}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream-adapter
```

cs-lead: Customer comms: we should highlight no billing changes and recommend staging testing. I'll draft the email and canned CS responses.

chris: SDK updates?

docs-engineering: Node + Python patches (v0.9.6) include header support and default concurrency bump to 12. Go/Java releases scheduled next week.

nina: Monitoring: new Console dashboard "StreamAdapter / ToolCall v3" and SLO 99.9% success. Alerts if error rate > 0.5% over 5m. If you see regressions, paste request IDs and tag @ops.

marcos: Noted. I'll run E2E tests across regions and post results here.

nina: Thanks everyone. Action list: docs publish, SDK releases, CS email, extend canary to 72h if any anomalies. We flip default after 48h opt-in if stable. :rocket:
